# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 22 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Sales & Major Land Bids

- **October 2026 developer sales surge to 1,716 homes** - Developers sold 1,716 private homes (excluding ECs) in October 2026, a 479.7% jump from September's 296 units and the highest monthly volume since October 2025, led by Thomson Reserve and Lucerne Grand. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/october-2026-developer-sales/)

- **$1.824 billion bid lodged for Jurong East white site with 1,200 new homes** - A CapitaLand-led consortium submitted a $1.824 billion bid for the Town Hall Link white site in Jurong East, within the Jurong Lake District, with plans to deliver 1,200 new homes near the MRT. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/1-8-billion-bid-turn-jurong/)

## Resale & Rental Market Trends

- **98% of Marina One Residences resellers recorded losses, with a median loss of $339,000** - In the 12 months to 18 October 2026, 45 of 46 resales at Marina One Residences transacted below the owner's purchase price, compared to only 5.2% of condo resales islandwide recording losses over the same period. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/marina-one-residences-45-46-resales/)

- **Condo rentals ease in October while HDB rents continue to climb** - Condo leasing activity slowed further in October 2026 while HDB rental volumes held largely steady, with the year-end holiday season expected to keep overall leasing activity subdued. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-rental-activity-slows-down-in-october-2026-as-hdb-rents-continue-to-climb/)

- **Shophouse transactions on track for a nine-year low in 2026** - Only 75 shophouse deals are expected to be recorded in 2026, with total transaction value down 18% to $675 million, attributed to a price standoff between buyers and sellers and limited available stock, even as rents hold at $6.50 psf per month. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/shophouse-sales-hit-9-year-low/)
